title: Feature: Sound notifications
body: Windsurf has a feature you can enable to have it play a ding sound when it's done thinking and it's the user's turn. This is great, especially if it's easy to turn on and off, and even more so now that Opus allows for very long turns (I'm currently 1091 seconds into a run right now), so I know when to turn my attention back to it.
author: Heilemann
